features.quote: Token budget: 200k tokens (input + output) per run. Hard kill at breach.
Hard loop kill: If the exact same bash command is issued 3 times in a row with no file edits in between, kill at that turn
features.justification_quote: Saves ~30% of tokens in Tier S.
Implement automated capping to avoid paying for 40 turns of pure noise
